_description: Stage 2 phoneme corpus derived from CMUdict. Phone counts use the primary pronunciation of every base word with stress digits stripped. phone_initials holds word-initial phone counts; together with phone_bigrams these are exact sufficient statistics for the full-corpus per-word-reset perplexity, so Part A need not be evaluated on the biased length-matched subset. G2P pairs are restricted to words whose letter count equals their phone count so the 1:1 alignment is unambiguous; every 5th sorted pair is held out for test.
